environment.method: Actual POST /api/canvas-video route plus HTTP, canvas-disk readback, and a real-page button check against the same disposable service

canvas.source: Self-made prompt and video target; no private assets or credentials

beforeRestart.clientResult: TaskCanceledException after HTTP timeout; no response body or local task ID

beforeFixFinding: The video endpoint waits synchronously for completion. A simulated upstream acceptance followed by lost HTTP response left no local task ID, durable pending record, or video query route for recovery after restart.

mitigation.code: static/js/smart-canvas.js saves the existing submissionUnknown/submissionWarning fields before POST /api/canvas-video. A failed save prevents the POST. Network loss, HTTP 408 or 5xx, and empty success keep the warning; an explicit 4xx rejection other than 408 or completed video clears the new warning. Cascade runState becomes unknown and stops claiming later rounds.
mitigation.warningReadBackAfterRestart: 视频请求可能已被受理；若页面或服务中断，远端状态未知。再次提交可能重复计费。

validation: tests/smart_canvas_video_unknown.test.cjs: 7/7 passed, including durable save gate, 503/408/network/empty result, definite rejection, reload warning, earlier warning retention, and parallel cascade stop.
node --check for changed JavaScript and git diff --check for tracked JavaScript passed.
The local integration probe used the actual FastAPI canvas PUT and video POST routes; a fresh server process read the saved warning back from disk.

Real page URL http://127.0.0.1:3017/static/smart-canvas.html?id=f07-video-browser-20261003&project=default: simulated 503 left a visible 提交状态未知 warning, refresh preserved it, and a second Run click showed the duplicate-billing confirmation. Dismissing it left posts_this_process unchanged at 2.
remaining: The saved warning is used by the existing manual resubmission guard, but it cannot recover an upstream video task without a queryable provider ID. The HTTP endpoint still has no local video task ID or durable task queue.
limits: The controlled generator records synthetic acceptance and then waits forever. It does not model a real provider's final result or billing. The page check used only the local disposable service; real-provider acceptance, remote query IDs, and other task types remain unverified.
